ly_do: Chủ dự án duyệt G1 23/10 17:42: D3 GIỮ "burned to the ground twice" (AUTHORSHIP dòng 397). Không đổi chữ.

sau: Samuel Pepys hurries to Whitehall and tells the King that unless houses are pulled down, nothing can stop the fire. The King sends him to the Lord Mayor with that order.
ly_do: Nháp mở bằng "He" nhưng câu trước (L12) không có người → chủ ngữ mơ hồ. Gọi tên đủ ở lần đầu Pepys xuất hiện trong Hồi 1 (thẻ nhân vật dời theo).

sau: The Lord Mayor, Sir Thomas Bludworth, is overwhelmed. Pepys finds him in Cannon Street, a handkerchief round his neck: "Lord, what can I do? I am spent. People will not obey me."
ly_do: Tránh nhắc "Samuel Pepys" hai câu liền (V02). Câu Bludworth giữ đúng bản đã sửa (Pepys d.1129–1131), không "piss it out".

sau: That evening, Pepys takes shelter in "a little ale-house on the Bankside" — about where we are standing.
ly_do: Lệnh GIONG-T4: giữ móc "a little ale-house on the Bankside" → trích NGUYÊN VĂN Pepys d.1193–1194 (nháp viết "a little alehouse on Bankside").

tach: The roads are jammed with carts.
The river fills with boats — and with goods floating on the water.
ly_do: Tách hai câu sang hai shot (M-d xe ↔ M-d sông) để lời trùng hình; chữ giữ nguyên.

tach: By evening, the great church is ablaze.
John Evelyn watches its lead run down the streets "in a stream".
ly_do: Câu chì chảy rơi vào shot M-d (5) chì chảy; chữ giữ nguyên.

sau: Every plot in the burnt City has its owners — and the people who have lost their homes cannot afford to wait years for it all to be redrawn.
ly_do: Nguồn nói "property-owners" + "couldn't afford to wait"; "a tenant, a lease" không có ở nguồn đã đọc (chủ nhà–người thuê nói ở L40, đúng Archer/Inner Temple).

sau: City surveyors — Hooke among them — stake out the widened streets, then the old foundations, plot by plot.
ly_do: Cooper (FIG 2000): 27/3/1667 Hooke và Mills bắt đầu cắm mốc phố mới/mở rộng, rồi cắm mốc + cấp chứng nhận nền cũ. "set out the ground" → nói đúng việc của nguồn.

sau: On London Bridge, the houses and shops are pulled down in 1758. By 1831, a new bridge has replaced the medieval one.
ly_do: LMA/AIM25 (Bridge House Estates): "In 1758 the houses and shops … were demolished … completed by 1831". Nháp ghi "by 1761" (Wikipedia) và "seventy years later" → theo nguồn lưu trữ.
Vế "painters come to this bank" không tìm được nguồn xác nhận điểm vẽ (Canaletto) → bỏ. "white" bỏ: nhiều chóp Wren bọc chì (không khẳng định màu khi chưa kiểm).

loai: cần kiểm → VIẾT LẠI AN TOÀN
sau: Around it, the City keeps changing, building by building.
ly_do: Chuỗi "Georgian brick, Victorian warehouses, banks and railway bridges" + năm cầu sắt chưa mở được nguồn có thẩm quyền (ICE 403) → câu khái quát, không thêm khẳng định.

sau: In the 1930s, taller office blocks begin to rise near the cathedral, blocking some of its best-known views.
ly_do: SPD 2012 §2.4: Building Act 1930 cho xây cao hơn; toà mới (Unilever House, Faraday House) che các tầm nhìn quen thuộc → nói đúng ý nguồn.
London Museum: "Even today, most of the City of London's streets follow a similar route to 500 years ago." + LoC 2025.

sau: In 1937, the cathedral's surveyor, Godfrey Allen, proposes a rule: new buildings must stay low enough to keep the dome in sight from the Thames bridges and the south bank. From 1938, the City applies it. It is called the St Paul's Heights.
ly_do: SPD 2012 §2.8: điểm nhìn "from the Thames bridges and south bank between Hungerford Bridge and London Bridge" → đổi "from the river and the bridges".

sau: As dusk falls, German bombers begin dropping incendiaries on the City — at least a hundred thousand of them.
ly_do: Giờ "just after six" chỉ có Wikipedia/sách thứ ba → BBC 2010: "as dusk fell on 29 December". Số: London Museum "at least 100,000 incendiary bombs"; "in a few hours" bỏ (St Paul's/GAC: tấn công gần 12 giờ).

sau: It is a Sunday. Many offices are locked and unattended.
ly_do: Brewers' Hall: "Many premises in the City remained locked and unattended"; BBC: "that cold Sunday evening". Vế "incendiaries burn unseen in the roofs" không có ở nguồn mở được → bỏ.
BBC 2010: "The mains were being bombed … the nearby Thames … was at an unusually low ebb"; Brewers' Hall: "bomb-damaged water mains … a low tide on the Thames".
St Paul's (GAC): "twenty-eight incendiary bombs fell on the Cathedral and its precincts"; BBC: "Bombs rained down on the cathedral. Volunteer firewatchers patrolled …".

sau: Across the City, the Guildhall's roof burns, and nineteen churches are destroyed.
ly_do: Guildhall (City): roof "razed once again" đêm 29/12/1940; London Museum + Brewers' Hall: 19 nhà thờ bị phá đêm đó. "several of Wren's churches" chưa có nguồn đếm → đổi thành số có nguồn.
St Paul's timeline: "The Cathedral, rising defiantly from the destruction around it"; BBC: "St Paul's was saved."

sau: For the second time in three centuries, a great stretch of the City lies in ruins.
ly_do: "the heart of the City is open ground" nói quá (phạm vi 1940 nhỏ hơn 1666). London Museum: đám cháy "stretched from Islington to the edges of St Paul's"; 19 nhà thờ + 31 hội quán.
"offices on the old plots, a new square beside the cathedral": năm/tính chất Paternoster Square chỉ có Wikipedia/blog → bỏ vế, giữ ý chuyển.

sau: Today, more than six hundred thousand people work in the City — the Square Mile.
ly_do: City of London: "614,500 City workers (Office for National Statistics 2022)". "on a weekday" và "footprint of the medieval walls and their suburbs" không có ở nguồn đã đọc → bỏ.

sau: And in this century, a cluster of towers climbs to the east, around Bishopsgate and Leadenhall Street.
ly_do: City (KAOC City Cluster, 3/2021): "Iconic tall buildings including the Gherkin and the Leadenhall Building have been constructed in the past 15 years" → "in this century" thay "from the turn of this century" (không khẳng định năm bắt đầu).

sau: New towers must also respect protected views of the dome from Parliament Hill, Primrose Hill and Greenwich Park — and from King Henry's Mound in Richmond Park.
ly_do: SPD 2012 §3.2: tầm nhìn St Paul's từ Alexandra Palace, Parliament Hill, Kenwood, Primrose Hill, Greenwich Park, Blackheath Point; King Henry's Mound (Richmond Park). "Greenwich" → "Greenwich Park"; "test every new tower" → "must also respect" (đúng cơ chế hình học của SPD).
The Royal Exchange (trang di sản chính thức): "adds two additional floors to the original trading floor"; "London's first purpose-built centre for trading".
Vetusta Monumenta (Univ. Missouri, ấn bản số): "Wren's … proposal … was submitted to King Charles II on 11 September 1666" (9 ngày sau khi cháy); Evelyn trình 13/9 (Evelyn d.1168, bậc 2).
